headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.
The demand from Singapore was likely to remain steady in the coming months, given that the prices of office assets have declined by as much as 50 per cent, according to Thomas Chak, head of capital markets and investment services at the property...

headlines.summary_zh: 高力国际数据显示，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产的最大非本地买家群体，受惠于香港写字楼市场低迷期间不良资产价格大幅回调的吸引。鉴于写字楼资产价格仍处低位，未来数月新加坡资金需求预计将保持稳定。

headlines.title_en: Honor updates IPO guidance filing report.
headlines.summary_en: CSRC's IPO tutoring disclosure system shows that CITIC Securities has released the fourth progress report on Honor's IPO tutoring. Honor completed its IPO tutoring filing in June 2025 with Shenzhen Securities Regulatory Bureau, with three prior reports. The latest report shows the tutoring period from April 1, 2026 to June 30, 2026. During this period, one new director was elected at a shareholder meeting, and changes in equity structure led to personnel changes among those being tutored. The fourth phase focuses on four areas: continuous comprehensive due diligence, project work meetings, assisting in improving corporate governance, and helping the entity evaluate fundraising projects. In the next phase, CITIC Securities plans to continue appointing the current tutoring team.

headlines.title: 业内人士：多重因素扰动，金价短期走势或以震荡为主
headlines.summary: 自6月下旬以来，伦敦现货黄金价格在4000美元/盎司附近反复拉锯。与之形成鲜明反差的是，7月以来A股黄金股率先“躁动”，部分龙头黄金股涨幅超过30%，明显跑赢同期金价。业内人士认为，当前金价中长期支撑逻辑并未发生根本改变，央行购金仍可能推动金价中枢逐步上移，黄金类资产依旧具备配置价值。但短期来看，市场仍面临全球流动性、美联储政策预期、地缘局势以及市场资金流向等多重因素扰动，或以震荡走势为主。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Insiders: Multiple factors cause disturbance, gold price short-term trend likely oscillating.
headlines.summary_en: Since late June, spot gold in London has been oscillating around $4,000 per ounce. In stark contrast, A-share gold stocks have been 'stirring' since July, with some leading gold stocks rising over 30%, significantly outperforming gold prices. Industry insiders believe the medium-to-long-term logic supporting gold prices hasn't fundamentally changed, and central bank gold purchases may still push the price center higher, maintaining gold assets' allocation value. However, in the short term, the market still faces multiple factors such as global liquidity, Fed policy expectations, geopolitical situations, and capital flows, likely leading to volatile trading. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.summary: 截至7月28日，年内收益率超过100%的基金仅剩6只，较6月末的246只减少240只。不足一个月，上半年批量涌现的“翻倍基”数量缩水97.56%。“翻倍基”阵营快速缩水的背后，是前期领涨的科技板块遭遇集体调整。7月以来，创业板50指数、科创50指数分别下跌23.16%、23.97%，市场由单边上涨转向高位震荡，重仓人工智能、半导体、通信等方向的基金首当其冲。值得注意的是，剧烈波动也进一步拉开了绩优基金之间的差距。部分基金因持仓高度集中而大幅回吐收益，还有部分基金凭借提前降低仓位、调整持仓结构，继续守在“翻倍线”之上。

headlines.title_en: Number of funds with doubled returns plunges, gap widens among top-performing funds
headlines.summary_en: As of July 28, only six funds had year-to-date returns exceeding 100%, down from 246 at end-June. In less than a month, the number of 'double-bagger' funds that emerged in H1 shrank 97.56%. The rapid drop is due to collective adjustments in leading tech sectors. Since July, the ChiNext 50 Index and STAR 50 Index have fallen 23.16% and 23.97% respectively. The market shifted from a one-sided rally to high-level volatility, with funds heavily weighted in AI, semiconductors, and communications hit hardest. Notably, volatility widened gaps among top-performing funds. Some saw heavy profit erosion due to concentrated holdings, while others stayed above the 'double line' by reducing positions early and adjusting portfolio structure.

headlines.title_en: Wall Street Breakfast | July 30, 2026
headlines.summary_en: Oil surged 8%, Dow dropped over 2%, Nasdaq fell for the sixth straight session, semiconductor index slumped over 5%, 30-year US Treasury yield hit the highest since 2007. Fed held rates steady and stressed inflation commitment, but three voters supported a hike. Warsh: 2% inflation target unchanged, maintain independence, focus on AI changes. Trump repeatedly warned of 'striking hard' against Iran, seeking tariffs. US escalated Iran sanctions, targeting Hormuz 'toll network' for the first time, blacklisting tankers, shipping firms, and insurers. US-Saudi joint airstrikes on Iraq widened Middle East front. South Korea: Will take more measures to stabilize stock market, mulls restricting retail purchases of leveraged ETFs, raising transaction costs. Moonshot AI completed over $3.5 billion Series F funding: valuation over $35 billion, Series G may close next week. Microsoft posted strong quarterly results; cloud revenue rose over 40%; capex below

headlines.title: 国家统计局：上半年文化企业营业收入平稳增长
headlines.summary: 上半年，各地区各部门认真贯彻落实党中央、国务院决策部署，积极推动文化高质量发展若干经济政策落地显效，促进文化产业提质增效，着力扩大文化产品和服务消费，文化企业营业收入实现平稳增长，文化新业态行业展现蓬勃活力。规模以上文化企业营业收入平稳增长。上半年，全国规模以上文化及相关产业企业实现营业收入72026亿元，比上年同期增长4.6%。分领域看，文化核心领域实现营业收入50472亿元，比上年同期增长5.5%。其中，文化投资运营、新闻信息服务、创意设计服务等3个行业大类营业收入实现较快增长，增速分别为10.0%、9.2%和9.2%。（国家统计局）

headlines.title_en: NBS: Cultural enterprises' revenue grows steadily in H1
headlines.summary_en: In H1, all regions and departments followed central Party and State Council decisions, actively implemented economic policies to promote high-quality cultural development, boosting cultural sector efficiency and quality, expanding cultural product and service consumption; revenue of cultural enterprises grew steadily, and new cultural business formats showed vibrant growth. Revenue of above-scale cultural enterprises grew steadily. In H1, above-scale cultural and related industries achieved revenue of 7.2026 trillion yuan, up 4.6% year-on-year. By segment, core cultural sectors achieved revenue of 5.0472 trillion yuan, up 5.5% YoY. Among them, cultural investment operations, news information services, and creative design services grew rapidly, with growth rates of 10.0%, 9.2%, and 9.2% respectively. (National Bureau of Statistics)
